vitest: vitest: the module its test functions and the vi helper are imported from
test: suss: code-unit kind; also vitest: the alias of it that declares a case
testCase: suss: discovery match type for test cases written as calls
block: suss: the testCase style where suites and cases are nested calls
describe: vitest: opens a suite of cases
skip: vitest: the modifier that skips a case or suite
todo: vitest: the modifier that marks a case or suite as not written yet
skipIf: vitest: the modifier that skips a case when its argument is true
runIf: vitest: the modifier that runs a case only when its argument is true
each: vitest: the modifier that declares one case per row of a table
for: vitest: the modifier that declares one case per row, like each
vi: vitest: the helper object mocks and spies are made through
mock: vitest: vi.mock, which replaces a module for the whole file
doMock: vitest: vi.doMock, which replaces a module for the imports after it
spyOn: vitest: vi.spyOn, which replaces one member of an object
allPositional: suss: input-mapping kind, one input per declared parameter
